name: Ear of Balgaras
summary: At Dun Modr, Balgaras the Foul's ear marks the warlock's end. Recovered from the Dark Iron commander's corpse, it gives Ironforge's mountaineers proof of his death.

sections.title: A Grim Trophy
sections.body: Balgaras the Foul commanded the Dark Iron assault on Dun Modr. The invaders sabotaged the Thandol Span and destroyed the local dwarven garrison, leaving the outpost in ruins. A scheming warlock, Balgaras directed his troops from the shadows and shunned personal combat. Longbraid the Grim, the mountain king's officer stationed outside the ruins, wants proof that the ringleader has fallen. Balgaras's severed ear confirms the warlock's reign at the northern border is over.

sections.title: Justice for the Fallen
sections.body: Dun Modr's fall cost Longbraid his brother and dozens of stout soldiers in the collapse of the West Bridge. The ear cannot mend the span or revive the fallen. With Balgaras unable to direct them, the surviving Dark Iron forces scattered through the northern Wetlands become easier for Ironforge's scouts to contain before another commander arrives from the south.

faq.answer: Balgaras the Foul was a Dark Iron dwarf warlock who commanded the warband that struck Dun Modr and destroyed the West Bridge of the Thandol Span. Notorious for cowardice, he sent waves of soldiers to die while hiding from Alliance patrols.

faq.q: Why does Longbraid the Grim want his ear specifically?
faq.answer: Longbraid the Grim wants proof that the elusive warlock has been slain. A severed ear is a classic frontier trophy that verifies the contract without making the bearer haul a corpse back to the dwarven camp.

faq.q: What happens to the Dark Irons once Balgaras is dead?
faq.answer: Without their calculating leader, the surviving Dark Iron forces in Dun Modr lose cohesion. Though they still haunt the ruins, Longbraid believes the Alliance can manage them before Ironforge's enemies send a replacement commander.

angles.text: For Ironforge dwarves, claiming the ear settles a bloody score for the kinsmen slaughtered during the Thandol Span sabotage.
Balgaras wielded shadow and fel arts from hiding. His defeat puts down an errant practitioner who brought ruin to the northern road.
